title: Leo's Cozy Bedtime Routine: Sweet Dreams Every Night!

lines.text: The moon rose high and twinkling stars began dancing across the dark velvet sky!
lines.caps: The moon rose high and twinkling stars began dancing across the dark velvet *SKY!

lines.text: Time for Leo's three-step cozy bedtime routine that turns sleep into an adventure!
lines.caps: Time for Leo's three-step cozy bedtime routine that turns sleep into an *ADVENTURE!

lines.text: Step one: Warm bubble bath that relaxes tired muscles after a busy day of playing!
lines.caps: Step one: Warm bubble bath that relaxes tired muscles after a busy day of *PLAYING!

lines.text: Step two: Snuggle into soft flannel pajamas and read two magical bedtime stories!
lines.caps: Step two: Snuggle into soft flannel pajamas and read two magical bedtime *STORIES!

lines.text: Step three: Share three things you were grateful for today with a loving bedtime hug!
lines.caps: Step three: Share three things you were grateful for today with a loving bedtime *HUG!

lines.text: Gratitude calms your nervous system, slowing down heartbeat into deep peaceful rhythm!
lines.caps: Gratitude calms your nervous system, slowing down heartbeat into deep peaceful *RHYTHM!

lines.text: Head on the pillow, eyes closed, drifting on fluffy clouds toward magical dreamland!
lines.caps: Head on the pillow, eyes closed, drifting on fluffy clouds toward magical *DREAMLAND!

lines.text: Sleep well, little dreamers, tomorrow is full of brand new discoveries and joy!
lines.caps: Sleep well, little dreamers, tomorrow is full of brand new discoveries and *JOY!

lines.text: Sweet dreams from all of us—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
lines.caps: *SWEET dreams from | all of us— *SUBSCRIBE | to *BABYBEATS | *RHYMO!
